description: The report develops an explicit coding rubric that itemizes all important factors varying across feedback studies, developed inductively by reading a wide sample of studies.
title: Biber et al.'s 16-variable feedback coding rubric

description: The article uses two prominent bibliometric approaches to analyze a research field: science mapping and performance analysis.
title: Bibliometric analysis combining science mapping and performance analysis

description: The bidirectional validity approach examines a test's fairness by working backward from the criterion: examinees are matched on the outcome the test is supposed to predict (here, type of math course taken and grade received in first-year college math), and their test scores are compared.
title: Bidirectional validity approach

description: The article uses Biggs' constructive alignment framework to structure a multi-modal curriculum evaluation across three aligned components: intended learning outcomes, teaching and learning activities, and assessment and feedback.
title: Biggs' constructive alignment framework

description: The article proposes \"a methodological framework for detecting the interactive scaffolding process in teaching behaviour using an imitation learning paradigm\".
title: Bivariate autoregressive Akaike-causality and noise-covariance method for quantifying interactive scaffolding
